items.exampleEn: She worked hard and achieved her goal.
items.exampleZh: 她努力工作，達成了目標。

items.exampleEn: Please refer to page ten for more information.
items.exampleZh: 更多資訊請參閱第十頁。

items.exampleEn: We need to replace the old sofa.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要把舊沙發換掉。

items.exampleEn: My parents always encourage me to try new things.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽總是鼓勵我嘗試新事物。

items.exampleEn: This is my first attempt at baking bread.
items.exampleZh: 這是我第一次嘗試烤麵包。

items.exampleEn: Hold the cup by its handle.
We need a new roll of kitchen paper.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要一捲新的廚房紙巾。

items.exampleEn: Our target is to sell a hundred cakes today.
items.exampleZh: 我們今天的目標是賣出一百個蛋糕。

items.sentenceEn: He passed the test on his second attempt.
items.sentenceZh: 他第二次嘗試就通過了考試。

items.audioEn: The handle of my bag broke, so I need a new bag.
items.audioZh: 我的包包把手斷了，所以我需要一個新包包。
items.questionZh: 說話的人的包包哪裡壞了？

items.sentenceEn: Did you achieve your target this month?
items.sentenceZh: 你這個月達到目標了嗎？

items.stemEn: The old TV doesn't work. We should ____ it.
items.stemZh: 那台舊電視壞了，我們應該把它換掉。

items.stemEn: Please ____ to the map on page five.

items.passageEn: Last spring, Peter set a target for himself: he wanted to run five kilometers in thirty minutes. His first attempt took forty minutes. His friends encouraged him to keep trying. He replaced his old shoes with better ones and ran three times a week. Two months later, he finally achieved his target.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，Peter 替自己訂了一個目標：他想在三十分鐘內跑完五公里。他第一次嘗試花了四十分鐘。朋友們鼓勵他繼續努力。他把舊鞋換成更好的鞋，每週跑三次。兩個月後，他終於達成了目標。

options: 三十分鐘內跑完五公里
每天早上都去公園跑步

questions.questionZh: 他第一次嘗試花了多久？

referenceEn: The handle of the door is broken.
rubricZh: 「把手」用 handle（例如 the door handle、the handle of the door）
「壞了」可寫例如 is broken、doesn't work

items.instructionZh: 用 roll 造一個句子，說說你需要或要買的「一捲」東西。
referenceEn: I need to buy two rolls of toilet paper.
Can you give me a roll of tape?
rubricZh: 用 a roll of＋東西表示「一捲」（例如 a roll of kitchen paper）
兩捲以上用 rolls（例如 two rolls of paper）
